criteria.evidence: Simplest interface. Just enter text and go. No technical knowledge needed.
criteria.rationale: Easiest system to start using immediately.

criteria.evidence: 7-8 seconds for 5s output. Fastest generation by far.
Spectrogram artifacts, muddy frequency response, high-end noise. Heavy EQ needed.
criteria.rationale: Worst audio quality. Inherent to spectrogram approach.

criteria.evidence: Great for ambient (dreamy, ethereal). Poor for clean rhythmic content (rock guitar).
criteria.rationale: Content-dependent like DDSP but opposite specialization.

criteria.evidence: Denoising parameter exists but BPM/key ignored. Limited control overall.
criteria.rationale: Minimal parameter control compared to others.

criteria.evidence: 'Isolated guitar' keyword helps but multi-instrument bleed common.
criteria.rationale: Difficult to isolate instruments despite prompting.

criteria.evidence: Manual tempo warping needed. Heavy post-processing required (EQ, reverb).
Perfect for ambient ideation (all outputs usable). Frustrating for rock guitar (heavy processing needed).
criteria.rationale: Excellent for sketching ambient ideas, limited for production.

synthesis.top_strengths: Fastest generation speed, easiest to use, excellent for ambient textures, rapid ideation tool
synthesis.top_weaknesses: Poor audio quality (spectrogram artifacts), limited parameter control, imprecise BPM/key, instrument bleed
synthesis.standout_feature: Artifacts that harm clean content actually ENHANCE ambient aesthetic - 'flaws' become features
synthesis.best_suited_for: Ambient texture generation, rapid ideation sketches, atmospheric soundscapes, background elements
synthesis.not_recommended_for: Final production quality, clean rhythmic content, foreground elements, precise instrumental work
synthesis.ideal_user_profile: Experimental artists and producers who need quick ambient inspiration and accept lo-fi aesthetic

entries.one_line_summary: Guitar riff generation requires heavy post-processing
Breakthrough: Riffusion excels at ambient textures!
